evidence_summary: Staged round-051 payload is docs-only and records the terminal publication gate as a deliberate hold. Local package validation, build, watcher-core test, Haddock generation, consumer example build/run, CI config scan, overclaim/no-upload scan, decision wording scan, moifold-owned policy scan, whitespace checks, and scope scan passed. Hosted CI was not observed, Haddock per-export/link warnings remain publication blockers, and there is no explicit operator approval for externally visible package upload.
